findings.distinction: Sensed control,physical execution and residual burden recover separately.
findings.blockedClaim: Functional recovery proves complete bodily clearance,or SKILL equality semantics replace biological semantics.
findings.reopen: New impairment or recovery laws must preserve independent control/competence and exact threshold comparisons.

findings.distinction: Hidden perturbation can lawfully change later admitted sensations through action outcomes.
findings.blockedClaim: Masking only intoxication guarantees whole safe-history equality.
findings.reopen: A new masking claim must cover all causally affected admitted channels or scope equality narrowly.

findings.distinction: Optional regulation goal,prior conditional knowledge,chosen operation and later frame are distinct.
findings.blockedClaim: Relief is outcome evidence,or a known strategy is necessarily beneficial or physically protective.
findings.reopen: New planning/control consumers require independent goal,evidence,completion and frame interventions.
